label: D1 after a reward, when about to choose a2, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the reward input is 1 (all activation mass is in D1 with in_rew == 1). It never fires on GO or D2 steps, on unrewarded D1 steps, or on a1 choices: 99.6% of the mass falls on trials where the agent goes on to pick a2. At D1 the action is the upcoming choice of the agent itself, which it computes; in practice this is the same as having just been rewarded for a2, because nearly all of these trials repeat a2. The policy logit is moderately in favour of a2 (choice between -4.4 and -1.5). The unit also depends strongly on time in the episode: it is active on trials 0-45 and almost silent on trials 50-89, with a small comeback at 90-99. Without the ep_trial term F1 is only 0.48. Value is in a narrow band (7.54-7.73). In the example windows the activation seems to build up over a run of rewarded a2 trials and is weak on the first reward after a switch or after an unrewarded trial, but I only saw this in examples; I did not measure it. Requiring the reward two trials back to be nonzero raises precision a little (dev F1 0.79 vs 0.78) but lowers mass recall, so I kept the simpler predicate. Dev scores: P 0.69, R 0.90, F1 0.78, mass recall 0.94.
